dataSchema.description:
Data of the event `email.message.delivered`. The mail system delivered the message.
`recipientCount` is the number of recipients that this one event is about.
A notification can be about only some recipients of a message.

senderApp.description: Key of the app that sent the message.

Type of a bounce. `permanent` is a rejection of the 5xx class.
`transient` is a rejection of the 4xx class. `undetermined` is a rejection with no known class.
